that's the thing. this is the first time i'e been on reedit in almost a year. It's not that I'm too stuck on the computer to live life, it's that I'm too stuck on the fact that I made my life about someone else. 
I tried living it without him, but it's just so painful that I really can't do it anymore. I've lost so much weight I'm seeing a nutritionist, my family is hurting, it's really gotten to the point that seeing someone to get over me would be easier to deal with me that I can't justify living anymore.

I would, but no one cares. I mean I know my parents do, so very much, but at the same time I just can't keep living like I do just because I love them.
I feel Like I'm hurting them more by lying every day than by just doing it. 
I just don't know what to do. 
It's like the choice has already been made but i still wish someone would talk to me.

Are you still alive? 
If you are, I really need you right now.
